verdict.rationale: The portal accepts 1099 information returns as XML files using the IRS IRIS schema, and offers W2/1099 submission. A single file can carry many records, so bulk submission is plausible, but the evidence never states batch limits or record counts. Beyond that, actions are per-item: amended GR returns are limited to one tax period only, no OpenAPI or machine-readable docs were found, and filings sit behind an authenticated interactive portal. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk operations beyond 1099/W2 file upload, programmatic or API-driven bulk actions, bulk amendments or payments across periods/accounts, independent corroboration.
